command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== step: check script exists =="
ls -l /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance
echo "== step: install cron job =="
CRON_LINE='15 2 * * * root /usr/local/bin/inventory-maintenance >> /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log 2>&1'
echo "$CRON_LINE" | sudo -n tee /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
sudo -n chmod 644 /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
echo "== step: ensure log file exists =="
sudo -n touch /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
sudo -n chmod 644 /var/log/inventory-maintenance.log
echo "== step: verify cron service active =="
systemctl is-active cron || systemctl is-active crond
echo "== step: show installed cron file =="
cat /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance
echo "== step: syntax check via crontab -n if available =="
crontab -n /etc/cron.d/inventory-maintenance 2>/dev/null || true
echo "DONE"
